verdict.rationale: Conta Simples is a corporate card and expense platform, so a conversational AI policy assistant is a fair axis for it. The evidence never shows such an assistant. The only AI mention is spend alerts and strategic insights by channel, which is an adjacent feature. The receipt-linking and transaction APIs are developer building blocks, not an assistant that chases receipts, explains declines, or pre-approves spend.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI assistant enforces policy conversationally — chasing missing receipts, explaining declines, and answering "can I expense this?" before the spend happens
